findings.source: RateLimiter._setTokenBucketConfig: s_bucket.tokens = uint128(_min(config.capacity, s_bucket.tokens)); s_bucket.isEnabled = config.isEnabled; ...
findings.issue: The keep-mask of a packed-slot update (0xffffffffffffffffffffff00ffffffff00000000000000000000000000000000: keep lastUpdated and the upper bytes, clear isEnabled and tokens) is printed as a hex constant times 3600 (P1), which hides that this is a field write of tokens and isEnabled.
findings.rule: Never factor a time unit out of a constant whose hex digits are only runs of f and 0 (a bit mask); more generally factor only when the cofactor is small and decimal-looking. Then split the masked write into field assignments (P15).

notes: Chainlink CCIP EVM2EVMOffRamp (solc 0.8.24, no via-IR). Source loops: OCR2BaseNoChecks.setOCR2Config remove/add transmitters (470, 480), manuallyExecute gas-override loops over messages and their token amounts, _execute's hashing loop and main execution loop (in transmit and manuallyExecute, e.g. `while s < _276` at 2913 with the 2-bit execution-state bitmap), getAllRateLimitTokens, updateRateLimitTokens removes/adds (276, 330), _releaseOrMintTokens in executeSingleMessage; all present as whiles (mapped by structure, not line by line). ERC165Checker's interface-array loops and MerkleMultiProof (in the commit store) are not in this bytecode. The other ~80 whiles are implicit ABI decode/encode loops of nested message structs (bytes[], token amounts), P7. transmit, manuallyExecute and executeSingleMessage (800-950 lines each) reviewed by structure. The token-bucket refill is shown distributed: `block.timestamp * stor4_128 - uint32(stor3 >> 128) * stor4_128` for (now - lastUpdated) * rate (see c00026's distribution finding). P4: stor16[concat(mem[0])] bitmap words.
summary: Faithful text with the source loops shown as whiles, but dominated by implicit decode/encode loops of nested CCIP structs; one packed-slot update hides its mask behind a P1 time-unit factorisation.
